subject: System Design
title: Why System Design Matters
description: A micro-lesson that makes Why System Design Matters usable.

hook.text: A startup's prototype works for 100 users. At 100,000 users, everything collapses.

buildup.text: Code quality alone can't save you. Architecture determines whether a system survives growth.

discovery.text: System design decides cost, speed, reliability, and how fast your team can ship features.

twist.text: The biggest tech companies spend more time on design than on writing code.

climax.text: Good design lets a small team serve millions. Bad design buries a large team in chaos.

punchline.text: Architecture decides if your system scales or breaks.

quiz.question: Why do big tech companies spend more time on design than coding?
options: Architecture determines if a system survives growth
